content.title: SpaceX recap: Live updates from St. Patrick's Day launch at Cape Canaveral
content.text: 9:36 am ET March 17, 2026SpaceX Falcon 9 booster lands on drone ship in Atlantic Ocean, ending 11th flightRick NealeThe Falcon 9 first-stage booster just touched down atop SpaceX's drone ship A Shortfall of Gravitas in the Atlantic Ocean, completing its 11th mission.9:34 am ET March 17, 2026Brevard County emergency officials deactivate after SpaceX launchRick NealeBrevard County Emergency Management officials have deactivated the agency's launch operations support team after SpaceX’s successful Falcon 9 launch.9:27 am ET March 17, 2026Liftoff!Rick NealeLiftoff! SpaceX has just launched the Falcon 9 carrying 29 Starlink satellites from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.9:22 am ET March 17, 2026SpaceX's St. Patrick's Day rocket launch webcast beginsRick NealeSpaceX's launch webcast is now posted above, right below our countdown clock.Liftoff is scheduled in five minutes from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.9:17 am ET March 17, 2026SpaceX rocket booster to land on drone ship A Shortfall of GravitasRick NealeThis morning's mission will mark the Falcon 9 first-stage booster’s 11th flight, SpaceX reported.The booster previously launched SES O3b mPOWER-E, Crew-10, Bandwagon-3, mPOWER-D, CRS-33 and five Starlink missions.Following stage separation, crews expect the booster to land on the SpaceX drone ship A Shortfall of Gravitas in the Atlantic Ocean 8 minutes and 20 seconds after liftoff.9:12 am ET March 17, 2026SpaceX's Starlink satellite constellation, coverage continues to growRick NealeThe past few days, Starlink officials announced their high-speed internet service is now available in Kuwait, Niue and the Central African Republic.This morning's mission will add 29 more Starlink satellites to the mix.9:06 am ET March 17, 2026Steady-state wind warning issued at Cape ahead of SpaceX launchRick NealeThe 45th Weather Squadron just issued a steady-state, 18-knot wind warning until further notice for Cape Canaveral Space Force Station and NASA's Kennedy Space Center.8:57 am ET March 17, 2026SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket fueling is now underway at Cape CanaveralRick NealeFalcon 9 fueling procedures are now taking place at Launch Complex 40, visual cues indicate.That means the Starlink mission countdown is locked in to lift off at 9:27 a.m. without any delays, or else today's launch must be postponed to a later date.8:44 am ET March 17, 2026SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket launch countdown highlightsRick NealeHere's a step-by-step guide to the minutes leading up to launch from SpaceX’s behind-the-scenes Falcon 9 countdown. T-minus:38 minutes: SpaceX launch director verifies “go” for propellant load.35 minutes: Rocket-grade kerosene and first-stage liquid oxygen loading begins.16 minutes: Second-stage liquid oxygen loading begins.7 minutes: Falcon 9 begins engine chill prior to launch.1 minute: Command flight computer begins final prelaunch checks; propellant tank pressurization to flight pressure begins.45 seconds: SpaceX launch director verifies “go” for launch.3 seconds: Engine controller commands engine ignition sequence to start.0 seconds: Liftoff.8:33 am ET March 17, 2026SpaceX launch to be 19th of year from Florida’s Space CoastRick NealeSpaceX's upcoming Falcon 9 launch will clock in as the 19th orbital rocket launch thus far during 2026 from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station and NASA's Kennedy Space Center.Click here for the FLORIDA TODAY Space Team's updating list detailing all of this year’s missions, complete with photo galleries and story links.8:22 am ET March 17, 2026SpaceX to launch Florida Falcon 9 on heels of California liftoffRick NealeEarlier this morning on the West Coast, SpaceX launched a similar Starlink mission at 1:19 a.m. from Vandenberg Space Force Base.That rocket propelled 25 Starlink satellites into low-Earth orbit.8:10 am ET March 17, 2026Strong-wind warning in effect at Cape Canaveral ahead of SpaceX launchRick NealeA strong-wind warning calling for 25-knot winds gusting up to 35 knots remains in effect through 9 a.m. at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station and NASA's neighboring Kennedy Space Center.7:59 am ET March 17, 2026SpaceX launch weather forecast details on chilly, windy morning at CapeRick NealeThe temperature stood at 52 degrees with a 20-mph northwest wind and overcast skies at 6:55 a.m. at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, the National Weather Service reported."Frontal precipitation will move south of Brevard County during (Monday) evening, leaving northeasterly winds overnight. Northeasterly flow in the low levels will allow for low-topped Atlantic cumulus development and the potential for a Cumulus Cloud Rule violation during the primary launch window," the 45th Weather Squadron's launch forecast said."Increased wind speeds may also cause liftoff wind violations on the primary day," the forecast said.7:50 am ET March 17, 2026SpaceX launch prep underway in Brevard CountyRick NealeBrevard County Emergency Management officials have activated the agency's launch operations support team ahead of SpaceX’s upcoming Falcon 9 launch.
